budget.title: Half-Day Budapest History with Budget Local Food
budget.summary: Quick but awesome dive into Budapest’s core history, followed by a cheap and tasty Hungarian meal.

schedule.title: St. Stephen’s Basilica
schedule.description: Start at one of Budapest’s most iconic buildings. Walk around the square and check out the massive facade.

schedule.title: Walk to the Parliament
schedule.description: Head toward the river and explore the Parliament area — one of the most photogenic buildings in Europe.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: End with something affordable and Hungarian: goulash soup, töltött paprika, or a budget-friendly lángos.

comfortable.title: Half-Day Budapest History with Comfortable Local Lunch
comfortable.summary: A short but rich historical walk with a proper sit-down Hungarian meal to wrap it up.

schedule.title: Buda Castle District
schedule.description: Wander around cobblestone streets, colorful houses, and historical viewpoints. Very fairytale energy.

schedule.title: Fisherman's Bastion
schedule.description: One of Budapest’s most famous viewpoints — feels like a real castle. Perfect for photos!

schedule.title: Comfort Local Lunch
schedule.description: Sit down at a comfortable Hungarian restaurant and enjoy warm, classic dishes in a cozy setting.

budget.title: Half-Day History with Light Budget Meals
budget.summary: A short history route and a simple, lighter veggie-friendly lunch — perfect for an easy morning.

schedule.title: Heroes’ Square
schedule.description: Kick off at Budapest’s grandest square, with giant statues and open space everywhere.

schedule.title: City Park Walk
schedule.description: Walk through Városliget toward the lake and castle-like buildings. Very chill and green.

schedule.title: Light Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Pick a budget-friendly café or bistro with salads, soups, or vegetarian bowls.

comfortable.title: Half-Day History with Comfortable Light Dining
comfortable.summary: Classic Budapest history spots with a nicer, lighter, modern-style meal.

schedule.title: Várkert Bazár Walk
schedule.description: A beautiful riverside walkway under Buda Castle — chill, scenic, and full of history.

schedule.title: Castle Garden & Old Walls
schedule.description: Walk around restored historical walls and gardens overlooking the river.

schedule.title: Light but Quality Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a comfortable restaurant with creative light dishes — soups, salads, veggie plates.

budget.title: Half-Day History for Curious Eaters on a Budget
budget.summary: See Budapest’s must-see history spots and try a couple of cheap local dishes afterward.

schedule.title: Shoes on the Danube Bank
schedule.description: Start with a powerful historical memorial right by the river.

schedule.title: Hungarian Parliament Exterior Walk
schedule.description: Circle around the Parliament area and explore the monuments and river views.

schedule.title: Mixed Budget Lunch
schedule.description: Order 2–3 small Hungarian dishes to sample different flavors without spending much.

comfortable.title: Half-Day History with Rich Food Taste
comfortable.summary: A deep but short historical walk followed by a tasting-style Hungarian lunch.

schedule.title: Matthias Church & Castle Quarter
schedule.description: Explore one of the most beautiful areas of Budapest — colorful roofs, old buildings, epic views.

schedule.title: Fisherman's Bastion Photos
schedule.description: Take your time with the viewpoints and explore the small passageways.

schedule.title: Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy several smaller plates of Hungarian classics in a comfortable restaurant.
